capabilities: Underline incorrect or incomplete AGLC4 citations and offer a one-click fix
Insert AGLC4 citation templates for cases, Acts, reports and other sources
Keep footnotes at the bottom of the note, renumbered, with working (n X) cross-references
Export to Word with real footnotes, AGLC4 headings and a bibliography
Import Word documents with their footnotes
disambiguation: Not a general citation manager for academic referencing styles; it only checks and formats citations to the Australian Guide to Legal Citation (4th ed).
extras: Fully offline and AI-free: no network requests, no telemetry, no accounts; citations are checked with fixed rules derived from the AGLC4 text. Full user guide lives in the plugin's docs/ folder rather than the README. Optional donation links (buy me a coffee, Patreon).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to validate legal citations against a style guide or to export notes to Word with real footnotes at the bottom of each page.
summary: Plugin for writing footnoted legal work to the AGLC4 standard, with live citation checking, Word export with real footnotes, and paragraph guides.
